description: Neo4j stores a graph: things are nodes, and connections are relationships. Its query language is Cypher. Learn a small graph of readers and books, then ask questions by following named connections. Use Neo4j 5+ locally with Neo4j Browser or another Cypher editor. These queries use fictional cma-prefixed ids. Cypher is not SQL and does not run in this site's SQL playground.
versionNote: Uses Neo4j 5+ Cypher labels, relationships, constraints and core matching clauses.
